summary: Agent-token creation is now bound to the authenticated user, cross-account handles return 403, the regression asserts that behavior, and the delegation documentation reflects the removed impersonation capability.

evidence: src/passport.ts now returns 403 when the normalized handle differs from the authenticated user and always passes that authenticated user to createAgentToken.
src/handler_test.ts adds a regression where an administrator requesting a token for another user handle receives 403 with the forbidden error.
docs/agent-login.md documents that the optional handle may not select another account and that Passport has no administrator impersonation role.
